decisions.decision: outcome badges in RecentInteractions use color-mix() instead of Tailwind opacity utilities
decisions.rationale: CSS custom properties (vars) don't work with Tailwind opacity modifiers like bg-[var(...)]/15; color-mix() is the correct approach
